title: NextLongIso pipeline parameters
description: Nextflow pipeline for multi-dimensional long-read RNA-seq analysis (isoforms, splicing, APA, promoters and transposable elements)

input_output_options.title: Input/output options
input_output_options.description: Samplesheet, reference files and output directory.

samplesheet.description: Samplesheet CSV with columns sample,condition and fastq (or bam for --input_type bam).
samplesheet.help_text: Sample and condition names may contain letters, digits, '.', '_' and '-' and must start with a letter or digit (regex ^[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9._-]*$). See the Samplesheet section of the README.

input_type.description: Input data type. 'fastq' aligns reads with minimap2; 'bam' starts from coordinate-sorted BAM files.

genome.description: Genome FASTA (uncompressed). Required for both input types (used by minimap2 and Bambu).

gtf.description: Reference annotation GTF (uncompressed), from the same assembly and with the same chromosome names as --genome.

te_gtf.description: Optional transposable-element GTF (TEtranscripts format). Enables the TE analysis.

publish_dir_mode.description: How result files are published to --outdir.

alignment_options.title: Alignment options (minimap2)
alignment_options.description: Options for FASTQ input. Ignored with --input_type bam.

minimap2_preset.description: minimap2 preset (-x/-ax). Use 'splice:hq' for PacBio Iso-Seq or other high-accuracy reads.

minimap2_args.description: Extra minimap2 alignment options, appended after the defaults (e.g. --minimap2_args="-G 500k").
minimap2_args.help_text: Appended after -ax <preset> -t <cpus> [--junc-bed] --secondary=no, so later options override earlier ones. Index-building options (-k, -w, -H) have no effect here; use --minimap2_index_args.

minimap2_junc_bed.description: Guide spliced alignment with junctions from --gtf (--junc-bed).

minimap2_index.description: Pre-built minimap2 index (.mmi). Skips index building. Must be built from --genome with the same preset.

minimap2_index_args.description: Extra options for building the minimap2 index (e.g. -k, -w, -H). Ignored when --minimap2_index is given.

junction_min_mapq.description: Minimum MAPQ of the primary alignments used to extract splice junctions (default 0: all).
junction_min_mapq.help_text: Applies to both input types. Junction strand comes from the minimap2 ts:A tag (or XS:A for other aligners); junctions without either tag get strand '.'.

tool_argument_options.title: Tool arguments
tool_argument_options.description: Extra options appended after the pipeline defaults. Use --param="value" when the value starts with '-'.

bamcoverage_args.description: Extra deepTools bamCoverage options, appended after the defaults (--binSize 5 --minMappingQuality 5 --normalizeUsing CPM --skipNonCoveredRegions).
bamcoverage_args.help_text: bamCoverage keeps the last value of a repeated option, so e.g. --bamcoverage_args="--binSize 10" overrides the default bin size.

bambu_args.description: Extra R arguments added to the bambu() call, e.g. 'NDR = 0.1'. Use double quotes for R strings.
bambu_args.help_text: Do not repeat arguments set by the pipeline (reads, annotations, genome, discovery, quant, ncore, lowMemory, verbose).
bambu_args.errorMessage: --bambu_args must not contain single quotes; use double quotes for R strings, e.g. --bambu_args='opt.discovery = list(prefix = "Tx")'

differential_analysis_options.title: Differential analysis options
differential_analysis_options.description: Comparisons for DESeq2, TE DESeq2, IsoformSwitchAnalyzeR and proActiv.

design.description: Design formula over samplesheet columns, with condition as the last term (e.g. '~ batch + condition').
design.help_text: Covariates are extra samplesheet columns. They are categorical (values follow the naming rules of sample names) unless listed in --numeric_covariates. Used by DESeq2 (genes, transcripts, TEs), IsoformSwitchAnalyzeR and the DEXSeq usage tests (APA, promoters). SUPPA2 diffSplice cannot use covariates.
design.errorMessage: --design must look like '~ condition' or '~ batch + condition' (samplesheet columns joined by '+', condition last)

numeric_covariates.description: Covariates of --design that are numeric (comma-separated, e.g. 'age,rin'); all other covariates are categorical.
numeric_covariates.help_text: Values must be numbers. Numeric covariates are centred and scaled to unit standard deviation before model fitting (recommended by DESeq2 for GLM convergence) and enter the model as linear terms. A batch coded as 1, 2, 3 should not be listed here: it is a categorical covariate.
numeric_covariates.errorMessage: --numeric_covariates must be a comma-separated list of samplesheet column names

reference_condition.description: Reference condition. Default: 'control' if present, otherwise the alphabetically first condition.
reference_condition.help_text: Every other condition is compared with the reference; fold changes, dIF and dPAU are <condition> relative to the reference.

isoswitch_alpha.description: q-value cutoff for significant isoform switches and APA sites.

isoswitch_dif_cutoff.description: Minimum |dIF| for significant isoform switches (IsoformSwitchAnalyzeR default 0.1).

isoswitch_consequences.description: Predict ORFs (longest ORF on gffread transcript sequences) and analyse isoform switch consequences with IsoformSwitchAnalyzeR.

isoswitch_n_plots.description: Number of top switching genes drawn with switchPlot (switch_plots.pdf).

usage_alpha.description: Gene-level q-value cutoff (DEXSeq perGeneQValue) for differential PAS and promoter usage.

splicing_options.title: Alternative splicing options (SUPPA2)
splicing_options.description: Splicing events, PSI and differential splicing with SUPPA2.

suppa2_events.description: SUPPA2 generateEvents event types (space-separated subset of SE SS MX RI FL).
suppa2_events.errorMessage: --suppa2_events must be a space-separated subset of: SE SS MX RI FL

suppa2_diff.description: Run SUPPA2 diffSplice for each non-reference condition vs the reference.
suppa2_diff.help_text: Runs only for conditions with at least 2 replicates, and only when the reference has at least 2 replicates. The events of all types are tested together. diffSplice does not model design covariates.

suppa2_diff_args.description: Options passed to suppa.py diffSplice (method, gene correction, ...).
suppa2_diff_args.help_text: Do not set the options given by the pipeline (-i, -p, -e, -o). See the SUPPA2 documentation for -m, -gc, -a, -l, -pa, -s, -c.

suppa2_alpha.description: Cutoff on padj (Benjamini-Hochberg over all events of a comparison) for the SUPPA2 significant-event table.

suppa2_dpsi_cutoff.description: |dPSI| cutoff for the combined SUPPA2 significant-event table.

apa_options.title: Alternative polyadenylation (APA) options
apa_options.description: PAS clusters from transcript 3' ends, tested with DEXSeq (see 'APA' in the README).

apa_cluster_window.description: Transcript 3' ends within this distance (bp) of the previous end join the same PAS cluster.

apa_max_cluster_width.description: Maximal width of a PAS cluster (bp); prevents chaining of distant sites.

apa_ip_a_frac.description: Fraction of A in the 20 nt downstream of a novel 3' end that flags internal priming (a run of >= 6 A also flags).

apa_internal_priming.description: 'filter' removes suspected internal-priming 3' ends of novel transcripts; 'flag' keeps and marks them.

apa_min_count.description: Minimal number of reads of a PAS over all samples; genes need >= 2 PAS after this filter.

promoter_options.title: Promoter usage options

promoter_method.description: 'proactiv' (default): proActiv on the stranded splice junctions (results/proactiv/; promoters of single-exon transcripts are not quantified); 'tss': promoters = clusters of transcript 5' ends, counted with Bambu read counts and tested with DEXSeq (results/promoter_tss/).

tss_cluster_window.description: Transcript 5' ends within this distance (bp) of the previous one join the same promoter (tss method).

tss_max_cluster_width.description: Maximal width of a promoter (TSS cluster) in bp (tss method).

promoter_min_activity.description: Mean absolute activity (log2 normalised count + 1) below which a promoter is Inactive (proActiv default 0.25; tss method).

promoter_min_count.description: Minimal reads of a promoter over all samples for the differential usage test; genes need >= 2 promoters (tss method).

proactiv_species.description: Species for proActiv's standard-chromosome filter (GenomeInfoDb species name).

proactiv_altprom_args.description: R arguments for getAlternativePromoters() (thresholds for alternative promoters).

promoter_options.description: Promoter usage: proActiv on the stranded splice junctions (default) or, with --promoter_method tss, promoters from transcript 5' ends.

qc_options.title: Read QC and transcript classification options
qc_options.description: Read-level QC (NanoPlot, seqkit) and SQANTI3 structural classification.

skip_read_qc.description: Skip NanoPlot and seqkit stats on the input reads.
skip_read_qc.help_text: Read QC runs only for FASTQ input; it is never run for BAM input.

run_sqanti3.description: Classify the Bambu transcripts with SQANTI3 QC (FSM, ISM, NIC, NNC, ...).
run_sqanti3.help_text: Uses the official SQANTI3 container (anaconesalab/sqanti3:v6.0.1, about 7.5 GB). Only sqanti3_qc.py is run (no filter or rescue).

sqanti3_args.description: Extra sqanti3_qc.py options, e.g. '--report skip' or '--CAGE_peak <bed>'.
sqanti3_args.help_text: Do not set the options given by the pipeline (--isoforms, --refGTF, --refFasta, --output, --dir, --cpus).

te_count_mode.description: TE quantification: 'exon' counts transcripts whose exons overlap a TE; 'span' uses the v0.1.0 rule (overlap with the whole transcript span), as a comparison option.
te_count_mode.help_text: Only the TE family/instance counts (and TE differential expression) depend on this option. To reproduce the published v0.1.0 results exactly, run the pipeline with -r v0.1.0. See 'TE quantification modes' in the README.

te_min_overlap.description: Minimum exon-TE overlap in bp (exon mode and isoform_TE_annotation.tsv).

te_strand.description: Count TEs on the transcript strand only ('sense') or on either strand ('both'). Exon mode and annotation.

te_autonomous_frac.description: Minimum fraction of a transcript's exonic length covered by one TE for category 'autonomous'.

resource_options.title: Resource limits
resource_options.description: Upper limits for any single task. Requests above these values are capped.

hpc_options.title: HPC options
hpc_options.description: Used by the slurm and lsf profiles (e.g. -profile singularity,lsf).

hpc_cluster_options.description: Extra scheduler options, e.g. --hpc_cluster_options="-G compute-<group>" for LSF at WashU RIS.

trace_report_suffix.description: Suffix for the execution report files in <outdir>/pipeline_info (default: launch timestamp).
